propositions: Store-wide compaction sweep executes one full `git log --full-history` walk per ticket inside the global write lock, blocking all writers for minutes
Per-ticket walk misses fall through to per-event wildcard-pathspec walks (`'*<event-id>*.json'`) that defeat pathspec pruning, creating O(events) full-history scans instead of O(tickets)
Sweep uses unscoped `git add -A` staging, allowing concurrent writer's uncommitted event files to be committed under compaction message
Sweep never re-yields mid-run: lock contention check happens once at start, then per-ticket loop proceeds without re-probing, blocking writers that arrive after sweep starts

Fix hoists position-keyed commit map build out of lock (built once per sweep before any lock), replaces per-ticket walks with single whole-store history walk, scopes staging to folded paths, and re-probes lock between tickets
